intervention_name: Cognitive remediation (Cogpack) plus Individual Placement and Support
intervention_description: 32 individualised one-hour computerised cognitive remediation sessions with Cogpack over 4 months, one to two per week, added to IPS supported employment delivered by a five-technician IPS team
IPS supported employment alone: rapid individualised competitive job search by employment specialists integrated with community mental health teams, continuous job support, no cognitive remediation

intervention_name: Group occupational therapy plus individualized occupational therapy (GOT + IOT)
intervention_description: Approximately three months of inpatient occupational therapy from hospitalisation to discharge, with more than half the OT time given to one-to-one goal-oriented IOT combining motivational interviewing, self-monitoring, individualised visits, craft activities with individualised coaching, individualised psychoeducation and discharge planning

Standard activity-oriented group occupational therapy already implemented at each site: physical fitness, craft activities, cooking, music, recreation and psychoeducation, with therapist assistance only on request

Whole recruited cohort of the Parachute early-intervention programme: five years of continuously available psychosocial and family support from small multidisciplinary FEP teams, with deliberately cautious low-dose short-course antipsychotic use. Not randomised and not employment-targeted, so the SAP 2.1 allocation safeguards do not arise.
